entities.summary: Trevor Anthony Williams is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Washington Nationals of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Pittsburgh Pirates, Chicago Cubs, and New York Mets. He made his MLB debut in 2016 with the Pirates.
